# Table (`table`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

Rows of records with typed columns, including status pills. Shows at most 50 rows.

**Use when:** The user needs to see individual records or exact values: open tickets, top deals, overdue invoices, a list of accounts.

**Don't use when:** The point is a comparison or trend (use bar_chart) or a single total (use kpi). Don't dump raw data: aggregate or pick the top N.

**Sizes:** M, L, full (default)

## Fields

Fields from `id` to `note` are shared by every widget.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"table"` | yes | Always "table". |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique id within the dashboard: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, e.g. "open-ar". |
| `title` | string | yes | What the widget shows, in sentence case with no trailing period, e.g. "Revenue by rep, Q3 2026". |
| `subtitle` | string |  | Optional one line of context under the title: scope, filter, or unit. |
| `size` | `"M"` \| `"L"` \| `"full"` |  | Width on the 12-column grid (S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12). Allowed: M, L, full. Default: `"full"`. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional footnote: caveats, definitions, or why data is missing. |
| `columns` | list of object | yes | Columns in display order. Put the identifying column (name, ticket) first. |
| `columns[].key` | string | yes | Lowercase key used in each row, e.g. "customer". |
| `columns[].label` | string | yes | Column header in sentence case, e.g. "Days open". |
| `columns[].format` | `"text"` \| `"number"` \| `"integer"` \| `"currency"` \| `"percent"` \| `"date"` \| `"status"` |  | Cell type. Numbers are right-aligned. date expects "YYYY-MM-DD". status expects {"text": "Overdue", "level": "critical"}. Default: `"text"`. |
| `rows` | list of object | yes | Row objects keyed by column key, already sorted in the order to display. A missing key or null shows a dash. An empty array shows empty_message. |
| `total_count` | integer |  | Total matching records before the top-N cut. When larger than the row count, the table shows "Showing 25 of 1,840 rows". |
| `empty_message` | string |  | Shown when rows is empty, e.g. "No open tickets older than 30 days." |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "table",
  "id": "aging-tickets",
  "title": "Open tickets older than 30 days",
  "size": "full",
  "columns": [
    { "key": "ticket", "label": "Ticket" },
    { "key": "customer", "label": "Customer" },
    { "key": "owner", "label": "Owner" },
    { "key": "opened", "label": "Opened", "format": "date" },
    { "key": "days_open", "label": "Days open", "format": "integer" },
    { "key": "priority", "label": "Priority", "format": "status" }
  ],
  "rows": [
    { "ticket": "TKT-4821", "customer": "Cedar Valley Schools", "owner": "J. Ortiz", "opened": "2026-08-14", "days_open": 59, "priority": { "text": "High", "level": "critical" } },
    { "ticket": "TKT-4907", "customer": "Bonneville County", "owner": "M. Reyes", "opened": "2026-08-28", "days_open": 45, "priority": { "text": "Medium", "level": "warning" } },
    { "ticket": "TKT-4950", "customer": "Wasatch Medical Group", "owner": "J. Ortiz", "opened": "2026-09-04", "days_open": 38, "priority": { "text": "Low", "level": "neutral" } }
  ],
  "total_count": 3,
  "empty_message": "No open tickets older than 30 days."
}
```

## Checks beyond the schema

- Error when a row uses a key that isn't a column key.
- Error when a cell's value doesn't match its column's format.
- Error when a status cell isn't {"text": ..., "level": ...}.
- Error when two columns share a key, or total_count is smaller than the number of rows.
- Warns when there are 50 rows and no total_count (the user can't tell if the list was cut off).
- Warns when percent values look like whole numbers (45 instead of 0.45).
